    Evaluating the contravariant defect #

    Evaluation is exact on the finite linear functor category. Consequently the value of the contravariant defect at Xᵒᵖ is the ordinary quotient

    Hom(X, C) / im(Hom(X, B) → Hom(X, C))

    attached to the second map B → C of the module complex.
